title: Enhanced high-temperature energy storage in semi-aromatic polyimides via dual regulation of short-range ordered and crosslinked architectures
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2405-2414
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04519J, Paper
Guanghu He, Hang Luo, Yuan Liu, Yuting Wan, Bo Peng, Deng Hu, Fan Wang, Xiaona Li, Jiajun Peng, Huan Wang, Dou Zhang
By the dual regulation of the short-range ordered structure and the cross-linked structure, semi-aromatic polyimide (E-SAPI260) attained a high Ud of 8.61 J cm−3 and 6.50 J cm−3 at 150 °C and 200 °C, respectively, with η exceeding 90%.
